questions.category: B1 — Use product and nutritional information
questions.question: A customer asks which bread has the most fibre. What should the baker check?
questions.explanation: Nutrition information shows fibre, fat, sugar, and other nutrients. It helps answer customer questions accurately. Guessing from appearance alone is not reliable.

questions.category: B3 — Adapt baking practices to meet dietary requirements
questions.question: A customer requests a gluten-free cake. What is most important?
options: Use the same tools without cleaning
questions.explanation: Gluten-free products must be protected from wheat contamination. Shared equipment can transfer gluten if not cleaned. Cross-contact can make the product unsafe for some customers.

questions.category: C1 — Prepare basic doughs and products
questions.question: A bread dough is mixed until smooth and elastic. What has mainly developed?
questions.explanation: Mixing develops gluten in wheat dough. Gluten gives elasticity and strength. It helps trap gas during fermentation.

questions.category: C2 — Prepare laminated doughs and products
questions.question: What is the main purpose of lamination?
options: To create alternating layers of dough and fat
questions.explanation: Lamination builds thin layers. During baking, steam separates the layers. This creates flaky texture and lift.

questions.category: C3 — Prepare specialty doughs and products
questions.question: A brioche dough contains high amounts of butter and eggs. What type of dough is it?
questions.explanation: Enriched doughs contain fat, sugar, eggs, or dairy. These ingredients add flavour and tenderness. They also affect mixing and fermentation.
